function tokenize(text) {
  return String(text || '')
    .toLowerCase()
    .split(/[^\p{L}\p{N}]+/u)
    .filter((token) => token.length > 1);
}

function scoreChunk(queryTokens, chunk) {
  const hay = tokenize(`${chunk.title} ${chunk.text} ${(chunk.tags || []).join(' ')}`);
  if (!hay.length || !queryTokens.length) return 0;
  const set = new Set(hay);
  let hits = 0;
  for (const token of queryTokens) {
    if (set.has(token)) hits += 1;
  }
  const titleHits = tokenize(chunk.title).filter((token) => queryTokens.includes(token)).length;
  return hits + titleHits * 2;
}

const input = $('Normalize Input').first().json;
let chunks = fallbackChunks;

try {
  const binary = $input.first().binary?.data;
  if (binary?.data) {
    const parsed = JSON.parse(Buffer.from(binary.data, 'base64').toString('utf8'));
    if (Array.isArray(parsed.chunks) && parsed.chunks.length) {
      chunks = parsed.chunks;
    }
  }
} catch {
  // keep fallback chunks
}

const queryTokens = tokenize(input.message);
const ranked = chunks
